Definition: a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned)
BiblicalUsage: tᵉshûwbâh is the word the Bible uses when it means a return, a reply. In 1 Samuel 7:17, his return was to Ramah, and it appears again in 2 Samuel 11:1.
TheologicalSignificance: Samuel returning year after year to Ramah shows me faithfulness is mostly just coming back to the same place God put you.
